verses.html: 1 A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
verses.text: 1 A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,

verses.html: 2 they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.
verses.text: 2 they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.

verses.html: 3 Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.
verses.text: 3 Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.

verses.html: 4 Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.
verses.text: 4 Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.

verses.html: 5 When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
verses.text: 5 When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

verses.html: 6 But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,
verses.text: 6 But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,

verses.html: 7 “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
verses.text: 7 “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

verses.html: 8 At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.
verses.text: 8 At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.

verses.html: 9 “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
verses.text: 9 “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?

verses.html: 10 But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,
verses.text: 10 But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,

verses.html: 11 “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
verses.text: 11 “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”

verses.html: 12 And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
verses.text: 12 And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”

verses.text: 1 And having entered again into Capernaum after {some} days, it was heard that he is in a house.

verses.html: 2 And many were gathered, so that it could no longer receive, not even the {areas} at the door, and he was speaking the word to them.
verses.text: 2 And many were gathered, so that it could no longer receive, not even the {areas} at the door, and he was speaking the word to them.

verses.html: 7 “Why does this one speak in this way? He blasphemes! Who is able to forgive sins except one, God?”
verses.text: 7 “Why does this one speak in this way? He blasphemes! Who is able to forgive sins except one, God?”

verses.html: 8 And immediately Jesus, having known in his spirit that they are debating in this way within themselves, says to them, “Why are you debating these things in your hearts?
verses.text: 8 And immediately Jesus, having known in his spirit that they are debating in this way within themselves, says to them, “Why are you debating these things in your hearts?

verses.html: 9 Which is easier to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven’ or to say, ‘Get up and take up your mat and walk’?
verses.text: 9 Which is easier to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven’ or to say, ‘Get up and take up your mat and walk’?

verses.html: 10 But in order that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins,”—he says to the paralytic—
verses.text: 10 But in order that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins,”—he says to the paralytic—

verses.html: 11 “I say to you, get up, pick up your mat, and go to your house.”
verses.text: 11 “I say to you, get up, pick up your mat, and go to your house.”

verses.html: 12 And having gotten up and immediately having taken up the mat, he went out before all, so that all were amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw thus.”

verses.html: 1 Sometime later, Jesus returned to the town of Capernaum. Then, people learned that he was in a certain house.
verses.text: 1 Sometime later, Jesus returned to the town of Capernaum. Then, people learned that he was in a certain house.

verses.html: 2 So, very many people assembled there. {There were so many of them} that there was no room for them inside the house or even outside the door. Jesus preached the good news to them.
verses.text: 2 So, very many people assembled there. {There were so many of them} that there was no room for them inside the house or even outside the door. Jesus preached the good news to them.

verses.html: 3 Then some people arrived {at the house} where Jesus was. Four of them were carrying a man who could not move.
verses.text: 3 Then some people arrived {at the house} where Jesus was. Four of them were carrying a man who could not move.

verses.html: 4 However, because of how many people were there, they could not carry the man close to Jesus. So, they went up on the flat roof of the house and dug a hole through it. Then, they lowered the man down as he was lying on his sleeping pad.
verses.text: 4 However, because of how many people were there, they could not carry the man close to Jesus. So, they went up on the flat roof of the house and dug a hole through it. Then, they lowered the man down as he was lying on his sleeping pad.

verses.html: 5 Jesus perceived that these people believed {that he could heal the man}. So, he said to the man who could not move, “Young man, I forgive you for your sins!”
verses.text: 5 Jesus perceived that these people believed {that he could heal the man}. So, he said to the man who could not move, “Young man, I forgive you for your sins!”

verses.html: 6 Now some teachers of the Jewish law were there. They were thinking to themselves,
verses.text: 6 Now some teachers of the Jewish law were there. They were thinking to themselves,

verses.html: 7 “This man should not be saying that {he forgives sins}. The only one who can forgive sins is God. So, he is insulting God!”
verses.text: 7 “This man should not be saying that {he forgives sins}. The only one who can forgive sins is God. So, he is insulting God!”

verses.html: 8 As soon as {they thought that}, Jesus realized what they were thinking to themselves. He told them, “You should not be thinking to yourselves that {I cannot forgive sins}.
verses.text: 8 As soon as {they thought that}, Jesus realized what they were thinking to themselves. He told them, “You should not be thinking to yourselves that {I cannot forgive sins}.

verses.html: 9 You may think that it is easy to claim to forgive this man who cannot move for his sins{, since it is difficult to prove whether this has happened}. Similarly, you may think that it is difficult to tell {this man who cannot move} to stand up, carry his sleeping pad, and walk around{, since it is easy to prove whether this has happened}.
verses.text: 9 You may think that it is easy to claim to forgive this man who cannot move for his sins{, since it is difficult to prove whether this has happened}. Similarly, you may think that it is difficult to tell {this man who cannot move} to stand up, carry his sleeping pad, and walk around{, since it is easy to prove whether this has happened}.

verses.html: 10 However, I want you to know that God has authorized me, the Son of Man, to forgive people on earth for their sins.” So, he said to the man who could not move,
verses.text: 10 However, I want you to know that God has authorized me, the Son of Man, to forgive people on earth for their sins.” So, he said to the man who could not move,

verses.html: 11 “Here is what I want you to do: stand up, carry your sleeping pad, and go home!”
verses.text: 11 “Here is what I want you to do: stand up, carry your sleeping pad, and go home!”

verses.html: 12 Then the man stood up! As soon as {he did that}, he carried his sleeping pad and left. Everyone saw him {do those things}, and it impressed all of them. They praised God and declared that they had never seen anything like that before.
verses.text: 12 Then the man stood up! As soon as {he did that}, he carried his sleeping pad and left. Everyone saw him {do those things}, and it impressed all of them. They praised God and declared that they had never seen anything like that before.
